function: Learned channel estimation for wideband XL-MIMO (near-field, beam split, non-stationarity) with an unrolled proximal gradient network: learned step sizes, U-Net proximal mapping (p. 1, 6).
system: Uplink TDD XL-MIMO OFDM, 100 GHz, 256 subcarriers; BS with 4 RF chains and ULA of 512 or UPA of 256x8 antennas, single-antenna users; no RIS (p. 3, 8).
method: Unrolled PGD with T=5 layers; learnable step sizes and U-Net residual proximal network per layer; supervised L2 loss with monotonic-descent constraint, primal-dual training, noise injection (p. 6-8).
data_channel: Own simulated near-field wideband XL-MIMO channel (beam split, random visibility regions, L=3 paths, CN(0,1) gains); 5e7 pairs per SNR, 3.5e7 for training; no standardized or measured data (p. 8).
test_conditions: Same simulated distribution for train and test, SNR -5 to 10 dB, pilot overhead varied; network trained at L=3 paths also tested at L=2-5 (p. 8, 10).
baselines: Non-learned: LMMSE, OMP with polar-domain dictionary. Learned: ISTA-Net+, AMP-SBL (deep unrolling, [45]), D2-CNN (same U-Net trained end to end); unconstrained PGD-Net ablation (p. 9).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR, pilot overhead, number of paths and number of unrolled layers; FLOPs in Table I (p. 9-11).
complexity: Table I reports FLOPs on the ULA setup: PGD-Net 3.79e9, D2-CNN 3.77e9, ISTA-Net+ 2.54e9, AMP-SBL 2.16e9 (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 8: "The generated channel data are used to create data pairs". Own near-field spherical-wave channel model with random paths and visibility regions (Section II-B, p. 3-5); no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 10: "(2) PGD-Net, where the network is trained only at L = 3 and evaluated at different path numbers". Tests a configuration (L=2, 4, 5 paths) not used for training (Fig. 8).
q3_support: p. 9: "AMP-SBL: A deep unrolling network combining approximate message passing and sparse Bayesian learning with learned parameters for channel estimation [45]". Non-learned LMMSE and OMP and learned ISTA-Net+, AMP-SBL and D2-CNN are all compared on NMSE (Fig. 6).
q4_support: p. 9: "Table I summarizes the computational complexity of deep learning-based methods, including ISTA-Net+, AMP-SBL, D2-CNN, and the proposed constrained unrolled PGD network". Table I gives FLOPs (x10^9): PGD-Net 3.79.
q5_support: p. 8: "The generated channel data are used to create data pairs". Self-generated simulation data; no code or data link, public dataset or measurement is given anywhere in the paper.
notes: The PDF is the arXiv v2 preprint (2505.07717) titled 'Channel Estimation for Wideband XL-MIMO: A Constrained Deep Unrolling Approach'; it prints no journal DOI, so the DOI-title match cannot be checked from the file. Deep unrolling with trained step sizes and U-Net proximal networks counts as learned (p. 6). q3 counts AMP-SBL [45] as an earlier learned method for the same function and D2-CNN as a standard CNN on the same problem; the unconstrained PGD-Net of Fig. 9 is an ablation and is not counted. q4 FLOPs are given for the ULA setup only (Table I, read on the page image). q2 rests on Fig. 8 (trained at L=3, tested at L=2, 4, 5); the other sweeps are SNR and pilot overhead.
